Definition
[index of a critical point]

Source: petersen:page-0277 A critical point $p\in M$ of a smooth function $f:M\to \mathbb {R}$ has index $m$ if $\operatorname {Hess}f$ is negative definite on an $m$-dimensional subspace of $T_pM$. If $m\ge 1$, $p$ cannot be a local minimum of $f$, since $f$ decreases along directions where the Hessian is negative definite.
